Question: Given \(AB\parallel CD\), line \(EF\) intersects \(AB\) and \(CD\) at points \(E\) and \(F\), respectively. Points \(B\) and \(D\) lie on the same side of line \(EF\), \(\angle EFD=70^\circ\), and \(EG\) bisects \(\angle BEF\). Find the measure of \(\angle GEF\) in degrees.
Solution: Angles \(\angle BEF\) and \(\angle EFD\) are same-side interior angles, so \(\angle BEF=180^\circ-70^\circ=110^\circ\). Since \(EG\) bisects \(\angle BEF\), \(\angle GEF=110^\circ\div2=55^\circ\).
